MORE:
This is to inform you that the Board of Directors ('the Board') of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e. Thursday 19th November, 2026, unanimously approved the following: - 

1. Allotment of 2,65,790 shares to Financial Creditors 

Further, Board also noted that 50,000 shares are to be allotted to retail shareholders (less than Rs. 2,00,000) as on 30.06.2019 and Company has requested KFintech (Registrar & Share Transfer Agent) for necessary guidance and documentation in this regard. However, the same is awaited. Board noted that same will be done in due course on receipt of relevant information from RTA.
NEWSSUB: Board Meeting Outcome for Intimation Of Outcome Of Meeting Of Board Of Directors On Thursday 19Th November 2026.

MORE:
Dion Global Solutions Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 19/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve With reference to captioned matter, this is to inform you that 2nd meeting of board of directors of company is scheduled to be held on Thursday, 19th November 2026 to discuss on the following: -

1. To discuss and allot shares to Financial Creditors pursuant to approval of resolution plan.

2. To discuss and allot shares to retails shareholders pursuant to approval of resolution plan
